caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair viewed from the front. The chair features three horizontal slats forming the backrest, with the topmost slat having a slight upward curve. The frame and arms of the chair are composed of cylindrical wooden pieces, with the arms extending outward and upward from the seat to the top of the backrest. The seat of the chair is flat and rectangleshaped. The chair legs are straight and cylindrical, connected by horizontal support bars, with two sets of parallel bars between the front and back legs and two diagonal bars along each side for additional support. The wood is rendered in shades of light and medium brown, showing the grain and texture of the material. The background is a plain off-white or light beige color. In the upper right corner, there is a faint, lightly sketched rectangular side view of one of the chair legs, annotated with small handwritten notes.
title: Rush Bottom Chair
